subject: Re: Deployment options & data residency — EU/APAC follow-up
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Deployment options & data residency — follow-up (next steps)

Hi Sofia, Luca —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Recap:
- Goal: Pilot LLM-powered customer support routing and redaction for EU customers, then expand to APAC.
- Primary constraint: Security team requires EU data residency for PII + audit logs. APAC pilot can be regionally isolated, but we need clarity on cross-region routing and log storage.
- Considered modes: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated reserved capacity (isolated GPUs in our infra), Private VPC/on-prem (full control).

Key items I promised to clarify:
1) Which deployment modes can guarantee EU-only data at rest/processing?
2) Region availability for Hosted API and timelines for adding eu-central-1 / other EU regions.
3) Cross-region routing options for APAC pilot without violating EU residency for PII/logs.

Answers (high-level):
- Hosted API: We operate hosted endpoints in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) and eu-west-1 (Dublin) for general availability — EU data can be kept in-region, but cross-region fallbacks (for resiliency) can be configured. However, for strict security requirements where no data may leave the EU under any circumstance, Private VPC or Dedicated capacity with contract controls is recommended.
- Dedicated reserved capacity: Can be provisioned in EU regions only and we support contract terms ensuring compute and storage remain in-region. Good middle ground if you want Redwood-managed infra but with stronger data isolation guarantees.
- Private VPC/on-prem: Full control — customer-managed networking, KMS integrations, no cross-region egress unless configured by you. Best for regulated workloads or audit/regulatory requirements.

Attachments: I've attached a short overview (Redwood-Deployment-Options.pdf) and a region availability matrix — will send updated matrix later today.

Proposed next steps:
- Technical deep-dive with Neha (solutions engineer) next week to map your compliance checklist to options.
- Procurement intro for Dedicated/Private pricing if you want a committed capacity estimate.
- If you'd like to start quickly, pilot can run on Hosted EU-only with agreed SLA/retention settings, then migrate to Private VPC for regulated flows.

Can you confirm which dates next week work for a 60-minute technical session? I'd like to include Neha and Marissa to cover architecture and commercial path.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying notes from our security and procurement:

- Security: We absolutely need assurance that all PII and audit logs for EU customers never leave EU control. Temporary cross-region fallbacks that replicate logs outside EU are a no-go for regulated flows. Is it possible to guarantee no cross-region replication for specific datasets on Hosted?
- APAC pilot: We'd like to run a limited APAC pilot in APAC region, but that pilot must not have any write/replication of EU customer data to APAC.
- Procurement: Please include an initial TCO estimate for Dedicated reserved capacity (quarterly/annual) and outline lead times for provisioning EU-only Dedicated nodes.

Looping in Procurement for pricing/discovery.

Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the specifics. Short answers up-front, followed by concrete options and next steps.

Can we guarantee no cross-region replication for specific datasets on Hosted?
- Hosted API: We can configure region-local processing and retention policies to ensure that model inputs and logs for a given tenant are only stored in EU regions. However, the Hosted tier by default has built-in fallback/DR paths that may route to nearby regions; we can disable cross-region fallbacks and add contractual controls, but for the strongest guarantee (technical + contractual) we recommend Dedicated capacity in-region or Private VPC.

APAC pilot without EU data replication:
- Supported. We recommend provisioning an APAC-only project/tenant for the pilot to ensure logical separation. Cross-region network egress can be blocked at the account/project level.

Lead times & pricing (high-level):
- Dedicated reserved capacity (EU-only): Typical lead time 4-8 weeks depending on capacity and GPU availability. We will provide a TCO estimate with quarterly and annual options; I'll have Marissa own the pricing proposal.
- Private VPC: Lead time varies (6-12+ weeks) and depends on networking/KMS integrations — Neha can outline prerequisites and a rough schedule in the technical call.

Attachments: Updated Region-Availability-Matrix.xlsx (high-level region availability and projected GA dates).

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule 60-min technical session (Neha) — available Wed/Thu next week (Apr 21/22) 10:00-13:00 CET. Please confirm.
2) Marissa to follow up with a Dedicated TCO/POC pricing note within 48 hours after agreement on capacity size.
3) If you want an immediate pilot, we can stand up Hosted EU-only tenant with disabled cross-region fallback in ~3 business days for a limited test.

Marissa/Neha: can you confirm the availability windows and whether we'd like to propose a concrete date/time to FinBank?

Thanks,
Aditya

Hi all —

Quick technical notes ahead of the call:
- We can deliver an EU-only Hosted tenant configuration that disables cross-region failover and blocks egress by tenant ID. This meets many compliance checkboxes but is still a hosted environment (logs and metadata remain in EU unless you request additional contractual controls).
- Dedicated reserved capacity guarantees compute and storage in-region; we can add a Data Processing Addendum and KMS integration scoped to EU keys.
- Private VPC gives you the cleanest boundary — no outbound traffic unless you configure it. If your security team requires absolute assurance, Private VPC is the only option that fully eliminates vendor-managed cross-region fallbacks.

Recommendation for rollout:
1) Start pilot on EU-hosted tenant (fastest) with egress/fallback disabled for EU customers only.
2) Run compliance and performance evals during pilot (2-4 weeks).
3) If security gating fails, migrate regulated flows to Dedicated or Private VPC; we have migration playbooks.

I'm available Apr 21 10:30-12:00 CET or Apr 22 11:00-13:00 CET for the technical deep-dive. Marissa, can you own the pricing proposal and lead times once FinBank confirms expected qps and model sizes?

Thanks,
